item.title: Please tell me why
item.description:
Please tell me why

Originally I believed that I was a Christian; yet I wasn’t as loyal as some devout Christians. Things changed when Trump began his mock-religious Christian showmanship. There are so many snobbish and interest-driven so-called Christians who get down on their knees for Trump to get some influence and power. It is so disgusting and unethical for them to sell out their conscience to appease a dictator. Never forget Trump’s Plaza Hotel offered a place for many pedophiles; never forget girls who became Epstein’s sex slaves had originally been Trump’s employees; never forget the relationship between Epstein and Trump. It is hard to understand poor people who support Trump even if they have to bear the skyrocketing cost for gasoline. It is easy to say Trump did more good things for his rich folks than for his poor MAGA buddies. Why do you support a convicted criminal? Why do you support a pedophile who was a loyal friend of Epstein, a sexual predator? What a great world we live in! Should we ask ourselves, ‘why so serious?’ - because the world is so ridiculous!

item.title: Net Positive, Net Frustrating
item.description: Today I spent a whole day, and only gained about $225.5. I made several correct decisions and several incorrect ones, essentially I wasted the day, the first correct execution was I bought 10 contracts 7535c at $1.25/contract, but I sold them at $1.35/contract; the second execution was I bought 10 contracts at $1.4/contract, but I sold them at $1.45/contract. Basically I gained just a bit from my correct decisions but lost a lot from wrong choices.
